stem:
Chirag and Leela each start with the same whole roti. Chirag cuts his into $5$ equal pieces. Leela cuts hers into $5$ pieces of different sizes. Each takes one piece and calls it one-fifth of the roti.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Only Chirag's piece is a valid one-fifth, because the whole was split into equal-size parts.
Both pieces are one-fifth, because each person took one of five pieces.
Equal size of the parts, not the count of pieces alone, decides a fractional unit of one-fifth.

teacher.key_rationale: A fractional unit 1/5 needs five equal parts. Chirag's equal cut is valid; Leela's unequal cut is not. Statement 2 is false. Correct pair is 1 and 3.
